text:
Liz: APNE3 GPU cluster is green — bootstrap + basic validation done. Ready to transfer daily ops to SRE on-call. Putting checklist, pager snippet and a few notes below. Please ACK and confirm PD rules and escalation path.

Hiro: Nice. Runbook link? PD service id?

Liz: Runbook uploaded: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/apne3-cluster (see Playbooks -> APNE3). Pager config snippet below: 

```
service: apne3-gpu-cluster
pagerduty_service_id: PD_APNE3_001
pager_channel: #oncall-apne3
escalation: [SRE-APNE, Core-SRE, Eng-Infra]
alerts:
  node_down: ">2 nodes or >10% GPU_UNAVAILABLE for 5m"
  gpu_eviction: ">3 evictions in 10m"
```

Samir: Paging order looks good. For clarity: primary -> SRE-APNE (Hiro), secondary -> on-call rotation, tertiary -> eng-infra. Confirm thresholds for GPU_evictions?

Hiro: Confirming. I'll be primary for the first week. Please add me to PD and Slack escalation. Also recommend adding a "degraded-gpu" metric to avoid noisy single-node alerts.

Anya: Cost note: initial pool = 32x A100. Baseline estimate ~ $22k/mo. Autoscale min=8, max=48. Set a cost alert if spend > $60/hr sustained for 1h.

Liz: Autoscale policy added to infra config and cost webhook -> #finance-ops + billing-bot. Healthcheck cron in cluster: `curl -sS http://health.apne3.redwood/v1/cluster | jq .status` (runs every 60s, alerts on non-"ok").

Samir: Can we do a 30min runthrough for on-call? I'll put together a short remediation cheat-sheet with commands for node-replace, draining, and PV failover.

Liz: Scheduled runthrough Tue 09:00 APNE (invite sent). Runbook sections to review: paging, pod kill remediation, node replacement procedure, network flap checklist, and routing fallback to eu-west3.

ops-bot: ✅ Runbook APNE3 uploaded and PagerDuty service PD_APNE3_001 created. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/apne3-cluster (edited) :white_check_mark:

Hiro: Ack :thumbsup: I will shadow for the first two shifts and take first escalation. Tag me for any live failovers.

Anya: Also adding per-tenant GPU quota limit to prevent a noisy tenant blast from pegging the pool. Will open PR for quota + alert.

Liz: Outstanding TODOs before final transfer: 1) Verify PD escalation rules and on-call rotations 2) Embed NTP + network-flap snippets in runbook 3) Confirm SLOs/SLAs in Console and link to runbook 4) Confirm billing alert thresholds. Tagging @Hiro @Samir for verification.

Samir: Got it. I'll verify PD rules in 4h and update the cheat-sheet. Closing handover in 24h unless blockers show up.
